data.name: 1 Hour Visitor Pass
data.headline: All ages! • Meet the animals
data.description:
*If you are staying with us, this is already included in your stay!*

#About 

Come enjoy an hour of fun and relaxation with the herd. This is a great opportunity for family and friends that cannot camp with Cascade Trails but want to meet the animals.

Don’t forget carrots for the horses and grapes for the goats 😊


#Tour Minimum

Please note the first booking on each tour requires at least 2 people or $40 regardless of group size. Each person is $20 after that.
data.cancellation_notes: Full refund for cancellations up to 3 days before visit.
data.booking_notes:
Thanks for booking! Please bring treats for the animals. The horses love carrots and the goats love grapes. Bringing water for yourself is also highly recommended.

Please wear closed toed shoes.

See you soon!
